Definition: from G5557; to gild, i.e. bespangle with golden ornaments:--deck.
BiblicalUsage: The woman on the beast is decked with gold, and the great city is decked with gold and precious stones and pearls. The gilding is the point: Babylon dresses its sin in splendour so that no one will call it sin.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Babylon's gold is a warning that evil rarely looks poor, and the church must not be dazzled by what is decked.
